page.content:
Scott's haunted-house film on the Nostromo.

How Alien (1979) connects

  • Creator: Ridley Scott — Scott directed Alien (1979).
  • Topic: Alien — Alien (1979) is the film that starts the franchise.
  • Character: Ellen Ripley — Alien (1979) is Ripley's first survival against the xenomorph.
  • Concept: Xenomorph — The 1979 film introduces the xenomorph aboard the Nostromo.
  • Creator: Dan O'Bannon — Dan O'Bannon wrote the Alien screenplay.
  • Work: Aliens — Aliens follows Ripley after the Nostromo.
  • Ship: USCSS Nostromo — Alien (1979) is largely set on the Nostromo.
  • Character: H. R. Giger — Giger's designs produced the look of Alien (1979).
  • Work: Prometheus — Prometheus is set before the 1979 film.

What is Alien (1979)?

Alien (1979) follows the Nostromo crew after a signal on LV-426 brings a facehugger aboard, and Ripley becomes the last survivor against the xenomorph.

Key threads lead to Ridley Scott, Alien, Ellen Ripley, Xenomorph, Dan O'Bannon and Aliens.
